summary: Bright Minds Biosciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 30, 2026, announcing its participation in the Foundation for Prader-Willi Research 2026 Research Symposium (October 7-8) and PWS Family Conference (October 9-10) in Philadelphia. The filing is a routine corporate communications update regarding the company's clinical-stage 5-HT2C agonist program, BMB-101, currently in the Phase 2a NOVA study for Prader-Willi Syndrome. No transactional terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No special-situation event is present; the item is a conference-participation notice with no deal or capital-markets implications to watch.
